candidate.title: Reschedule/merge deletes only the first calendar reference, orphaning events on other hosts’ calendars
reports: packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:454 — cancelling all instances of a recurring collective booking deletes only the first calendar reference for each instance

updbooking.references.find(...) in handlecancelbooking.ts still takes only the first calendar reference of each updated booking, so collective members' events on other references are not cleaned up on cancellation.

the recurring cancellation sweep now executes once per calendar reference, so with n references each remaining event is deleted n times, with the second pass guaranteed to error (caught and logged) (packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts ~437-460)

cancellation recurring-branch re-executes per reference: the recurring/allremainingbookings branch inside the per-reference loop ignores the reference and runs the entire deletion set n times, duplicating delete api calls and apideletes entries (packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:~437-455)

[high/bug] packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:439 — recurring cancellation resolves each reference's credential but ignores it, iterates only the booking owner's credentials, and repeatedly uses each updated booking's first calendar reference, leaving secondary-host recurring events undeleted.

[low/bug] packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:~445 — the recurring-event deletion block now sits inside the per-reference loop, so with multiple calendar references it executes once per reference and attempts to delete the same updated bookings' events multiple times (duplicate api calls/errors).
